verses.translation: Now these were the sons of David that were born to him in Chebron; the first-born Amnon, born of Achinaam the Jezraelitess; the second Damniel, of Abigaia the Carmelitess.

translations.ron: Fiii lui David, care i s-au născut în Hebron, au fost: întâiul născut Amnon din Ahinoama Izreeliteanca; al doilea, Daniel, din Abigail Carmeliteanca.

verses.translation: The third, Abessalom, the son of Mocha the daughter of Tholmai king of Gedsur; the fourth, Adonia the son of Aggith.

translations.ron: Al treilea, Abesalom, fiul Maacăi, fata lui Talmai, regele din Gheşur; al patrulea, Adonia, fiul Haghitei;

verses.translation: The fifth, Saphatia, the son of Abital; the sixth, Jethraam, born of Agla his wife.

translations.ron: Al cincilea, Şefatia din Abitala; al şaselea, Itrean din Egla, femeia sa.

verses.translation: Six were born to him in Chebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months: and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

translations.ron: Aceşti şase i s-au născut în Hebron. În Hebron David a domnit şapte ani şi şase luni, iar în Ierusalim a domnit treizeci şi trei de ani.

verses.translation: And these were born to him in Jerusalem; Samaa, Sobab, Nathan, and Solomon; four of Bersabee the daughter of Amiel:

translations.ron: Iată şi cei ce i s-au născut în Ierusalim: Şimea, Şobab, Natan şi Solomon, patru, din Batşeba, fiica lui Amiel.

verses.translation: and Ebaar, and Elisa, and Eliphaleth,

translations.ron: Ibhar, Elişama, Elifelet,

verses.translation: and Nagai, and Naphec, and Japhie,

translations.ron: Nogah, Nefeg, Iafia,

verses.translation: and Helisama, and Eliada, and Eliphala, nine.

translations.ron: Elişama, Eliada şi Elifelet; în total nouă.

verses.translation: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and there was also Themar their sister.

translations.ron: Aceştia sunt toţi fiii lui David, afară de cei de la ţiitoare. Iar sora lor era Tamara.

verses.translation: The sons of Solomon; Roboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Josaphat his son,

translations.ron: Fiul lui Solomon este Roboam; fiul acestuia este Abia, iar al acestuia, Asa, iar al lui Asa este Iosafat.

verses.translation: Joram his son, Ochozias his son, Joas his son,

translations.ron: Fiul acestuia este Ioram, al acestuia este Ahazia şi al acestuia este Ioaş.

verses.translation: Amasias his son, Azarias his son, Joathan his son,

translations.ron: Fiul lui este Amasia, al acestuia este Azaria, iar al acestuia este Ioatam.

verses.translation: Achaz his son, Ezekias his son, Manasses his son,

translations.ron: Fiul acestuia este Ahaz, al acestuia este Iezechia, iar al acestuia este Manase;

verses.translation: Amon his son, Josia his son.

translations.ron: Fiul acestuia este Amon, iar al acestuia este Iosia.

verses.translation: And the sons of Josia; the first-born Joanan, the second Joakim, the third Sedekias, the fourth Salum.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iosia au fost: întâiul născut Iohanan, al doilea Ioiachim, al treilea Sedechia şi al patrulea Şalum.

verses.translation: And the sons of Joakim; Jechonias his son, Sedekias his son.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ioiachim au fost: Iehonia, fiul lui; Sedechia, fiul lui.

verses.translation: And the sons of Jechonias; Asir, Salathiel his son,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iehonia, cel dus în robie, au fost: Salatiel,

verses.translation: Melchiram, and Phadaias, and Sanesar, and Jekimia, and Hosamath, and Nabadias.

translations.ron: Malchiram, Pedaia, Şenaţar, Iecamia, Hoşama şi Nedabia.

verses.translation: And the sons of Phadaias; Zorobabel, and Semei: and the sons of Zorobabel; Mosollam, and Anania, and Salomethi was their sister.

translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Pedaia au fost: Zorobabel şi Şimei. Iar fiii lui Zorobabel au fost: Meşulam şi Hanania, şi sora lor Şelomit.

verses.translation: And Asube, and Ool, and Barachia, and Asadia, and Asobed, five.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Meşulam: Haşuba, Ohel, Berechia, Hasadia şi Iuşab-Hesed.

verses.translation: And the sons of Anania, Phalettia, and Jesias his son, Raphal his son, Orna his son, Abdia his son, Sechenias his son.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Hanania au fost Pelatia şi Isaia; fiul acestuia a fost Refaia, al acestuia a fost Arnan, al acestuia a fost Obadia, iar al acestuia Şecania.

verses.translation: And the son of Sechenias; Samaia: and the sons of Samaia; Chattus, and Joel, and Berri and Noadia, and Saphath, six.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Şecania au fost şase: Şemaia, Hatuş, Igheal, Bariah, Nearia şi Şafat.

verses.translation: And the sons of Noadia: Elithenan, and Ezekia, and Ezricam, three.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Nearia au fost trei: Elioenai, Iezechia şi Azricam.

verses.translation: And the sons of Elithenan; Odolia, and Heliasebon, and Phadaia, and Akub, and Joanan, and Dalaaïa, and Anan, seven.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Elioenai au fost şapte: Hodavia, Eliaşib, Pelaia, Acub, Iohanan, Delaia şi Anani.
